messages:
Jordan: main CI just turned red after the merge (commit abc123). smoke/queue-runner failing across multiple shards, grpc timeouts. who can take a quick look?
Sasha: saw it too, flags show a bunch of 'deadline exceeded' in shard-4. throwing a ping to infra.
Jordan: @Alex can you eyeball the failing job?
Alex: on it, kicking a rerun for the smoke job now.
ci-bot: Rerun started for job smoke-queue-runner (job_id=98765)
Maria: if rerun fails, bisect ASAP. I suspect the scheduling/backoff changes from earlier today.
Sasha: +1. if it's transient we'll close, otherwise bisect + hold merges.
Alex: rerun just finished — failed with same stack. grabbing pod logs.
Alex: logs:
```
E grpc: deadline exceeded while waiting for response
...
Pod kubelet reports: CPU usage spike to 95% on enqueue loop
```
Jordan: weird — could be autoscaler reacting badly. @Maria did you land any autoscaler tweaks today?
Maria: yep, PR #4567 bumped minReplicas for queue-workers from 1 -> 2 and adjusted backoff window. merged ~20m ago.
Sasha: that PR also changed the enqueue backoff jitter. tagging @infra-team for visibility.
Jordan: ok, filing bisect. Command in case someone else runs it: `ci-bisect --since 1767400000 --to 1767512345 --test smoke/queue-runner`
Alex: starting bisect now, ETA ~10m.
ci-bot: Bisect started (id=333) — testing commit range abc000..abc123
Alex: bisect finished: suspect commit abc0f9 (touched scheduler + backoff).
Sasha: that matches the theory. recommend revert for hotfix.
Jordan: please open revert PR and request urgent merge, set merge-blockers accordingly.
Alex: PR opened (revert/abc0f9), adding urgent label and pinging release leads.
ci-bot: Hotfix deploy queued for revert branch (deploy_id=555)
Maria: rerun smoke after revert queued.
ci-bot: Rerun passed. All smoke checks green.
Jordan: nice work — rolling brief postmortem and closing this thread. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
